body.x: Samsung Electronics(www.samsung.com) announced 'Galaxy Camera 2' at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show that is being held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
The new Galaxy Camera 2 features a 21x zoom lens to get you closer to the action, plus a 4.8” HD Super Clear LCD display, which allows you to frame or view images in incredible detail.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
